question: GQ-008
subject: size, not row count, was the thing to control
what_i_said_last_turn: "Row-count retention does not control this file — size does. That remains open."

the_column.what_it_is: a verbatim copy of my own prompt on every request
the_column.how_i_checked: inspected every derivations block in metrics/ and the observatory snapshot — NOT a grep of whole files, which returns 20 hits because the column names appear in prose describing the growth

result.honest_reading: the file did NOT shrink and I am not claiming it did. 46% of its pages are now free for reuse, so new rows land in reclaimed space instead of extending the file. That is the bounded win available without a rebuild.

three_things_the_dry_run_on_a_COPY_caugh.what: VACUUM failed with "database or disk is full"
three_things_the_dry_run_on_a_COPY_caugh.cause: VACUUM rebuilds alongside the original, needing ~2x the file size; 9.5 GB against 19 GB free with a live writer
three_things_the_dry_run_on_a_COPY_caugh.consequence_avoided: on the real database that would have failed mid-rebuild
three_things_the_dry_run_on_a_COPY_caugh.fix: guard the vacuum on free space and state plainly what is skipped

three_things_the_dry_run_on_a_COPY_caugh.what: the copy itself consumed 9.5 GB, taking free space 28Gi -> 19Gi
three_things_the_dry_run_on_a_COPY_caugh.lesson: my own safety measure was the thing that made the operation unsafe

three_things_the_dry_run_on_a_COPY_caugh.what: a derivation answer read 45264719 against the expected 45285517
three_things_the_dry_run_on_a_COPY_caugh.cause: my earlier eviction deleted 136 rows including CodexOpenAI ones — the slice preserves the pre-deletion total
three_things_the_dry_run_on_a_COPY_caugh.verdict: not a defect. This is exactly what the slice exists for.

a_guard_that_would_have_blocked_itself_f.what: the pre-delete check compared slice against LIVE and refused at 1/5
a_guard_that_would_have_blocked_itself_f.why_wrong: after the first successful eviction, live and slice ALWAYS differ — that is the point of an archive
a_guard_that_would_have_blocked_itself_f.fix: probe the slice directly: does it ANSWER, not does it agree with a source that has moved on
a_guard_that_would_have_blocked_itself_f.and: an empty answer counts as failure, since two blanks compare equal
